title: Mathematics and mysticism: another defense of human mathematics
author: Ignacio Barros

metaphors.title: The dim light of mystery
metaphors.paraphrase: Answers are a blinding light; real mathematics happens in the dimness between answers and darkness, as religion accepts its relationship to mystery.
metaphors.style_hint: A chapel lit by a single candle against a glare outside.

metaphors.title: Settlers and their machines
metaphors.paraphrase: AI builders as settlers who arrive with powerful machines to take over the land of mathematics.
metaphors.style_hint: Wagons and machines at the edge of a field.

metaphors.title: Earthquake and rubble
metaphors.paraphrase: The upheaval is an ongoing earthquake and a loud maelstrom that buries the field's deeper values in rubble; waiting for the sea to calm is not an option.
metaphors.style_hint: A cracked building with rubble and a stormy sea behind.

metaphors.title: Understanding as clothing
metaphors.paraphrase: Reason and understanding are clothes wrapped around creativity, giving it shelter and warmth, while creation itself is the body.
metaphors.style_hint: A tailor's shop with a coat on a mannequin.

metaphors.title: Breathing life into objects
metaphors.paraphrase: Defining a mathematical object spells a form of life into a mind-conceived thing; the delicate, glacial objects die if humans stop breathing life into them.
metaphors.style_hint: A crystalline form with a faint pulse.

metaphors.title: The pandemic of progress
metaphors.paraphrase: The drive for rapid change is an infection, a fever that mathematics predates; mathematicians are almost allergic to the comfort of answers.
